name: Hierarchical Finite Element Slice Extraction
definition: An algorithm to reconstruct a 2D slice $S_2$ from a compressed 4D function $f_c$ given a focus point $p$, using finite element properties and Lagrange polynomials to compute function values at the finest resolution level.
summary: Hierarchical Finite Element Slice Extraction reconstructs 2D slices from compressed 4D functions using Lagrange polynomials and sparse hierarchical traversal for efficient random access.
